description: This file defines onboarding-related logic in a Swift project, including connection modes, onboarding state management, and user defaults handling.

methods.name: shouldPresentOnLaunch
methods.description: Determines if onboarding should be presented at app launch based on onboarding completion status, last gateway connection, and app model state.

methods.name: markCompleted
methods.description: Marks onboarding as completed, optionally recording the connection mode and timestamp.

methods.name: shouldPresentFirstRunIntro
methods.description: Checks if the first run introduction should be shown to the user.

methods.name: markFirstRunIntroSeen
methods.description: Marks the first run intro as seen.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets onboarding state flags in user defaults.

methods.name: lastMode
methods.description: Retrieves the last connection mode from user defaults, if available.
